tasks.label: configure (host)
tasks.detail: Host-only: configures ${workspaceFolder}/build. Do not run this inside the devcontainer -- that directory is the same bind-mounted tree the host already configured at a different absolute path, and CMake refuses the mismatch.

tasks.label: build (container)
tasks.detail: Rebuilds the container-local tree devcontainer.json's postCreateCommand configures -- what (gdb) Launch gman debugs. Default build task inside the devcontainer.

tasks.label: test (container)
tasks.detail: Default test task inside the devcontainer.

tasks.label: gates
tasks.detail: Builds the dev container and runs AGENTS.md's full gate list inside it -- the same command CI's checks are derived from.
